title: Using Real Trees to Bring Nature Indoors
titleZh: 运用仿真树木将自然引入室内
credits: Kim Cook reported this story for the Associated Press from New York, New York. Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: There is a growing movement worldwide to use plants in building design to establish closer connections with nature and soften hard city styles.
sentences.zh: 全球范围内出现了一股日益壮大的潮流，在建筑设计中引入植物，以建立与更密切的自然联系并软化硬朗的城市风格。

sentences.en: The movement also seeks to improve designs to help protect the environment and increase personal wellness.
sentences.zh: 这股潮流还致力于改进设计，以帮助保护环境并提升个人健康。

sentences.en: Many of the efforts by architects and designers have centered on one natural element: trees.
sentences.zh: 建筑师和设计师的许多努力都聚焦于一种自然元素：树木。

sentences.en: Examples of such design can be found in many places, including New York City.
sentences.zh: 此类设计的例子随处可见，包括纽约市。

sentences.en: A building in Manhattan that houses the Ford Foundation has a 12-story light-filled entrance area, or atrium.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿一座容纳福特基金会的建筑拥有一个12层高、光线充足的入口区，或称中庭。

sentences.en: It is also filled with plants and flowers including magnolias, eucalyptus, jacaranda, cryptomeria, iron bark and pear trees.
sentences.zh: 其中也种满了各类植物和花卉，包括玉兰、桉树、蓝花楹、日本柳杉、铁木和梨树。

sentences.en: Another example sits within New York City’s Brookfield Place shopping center.
sentences.zh: 另一个例子位于纽约市的 Brookfield Place 购物中心内。

sentences.en: The center’s main atrium includes a collection of 12-meter-tall Washingtonia palm trees.
sentences.zh: 该购物中心的中庭收藏了一组高达12米的华盛顿棕榈树。

sentences.en: In Singapore, the city-state’s Jewel Changi airport offers travelers an inviting environment.
sentences.zh: 在新加坡，这座城市国家的新加坡樟宜机场为旅客提供了一个诱人的环境。

sentences.en: It has 2,500 trees native to nations including Madagascar, Australia, Malaysia and Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 这里种植了2500棵原产于马达加斯加、澳大利亚、马来西亚和印度尼西亚等国的树木。

sentences.en: The airport includes a 2.4-hectare indoor forest with walking paths.
sentences.zh: 该机场包含一个占地2.4公顷、设有步行道的室内森林。

sentences.en: Some apartments and mixed-use buildings are also putting trees and other greenery into their designs.
sentences.zh: 一些公寓和混合用途建筑也将其设计和树木及其他绿植融入其中。

sentences.en: Such buildings are sometimes called “greenscrapers,” a term that comes from the word “skyscraper.”
sentences.zh: 这类建筑有时被称为"绿色摩天楼"，这一词源于"摩天大楼"一词。

sentences.en: In Milan, Italy, architect Stefano Boeri designed Bosco Verticale, a 44-story building with 800 trees and other greenery.
sentences.zh: 在意大利米兰，建筑师斯特凡诺·博埃里设计了垂直森林，这是一座44层高的建筑，种有800棵树木及其他绿植。

sentences.en: In the Netherlands, he also built the Trudo Vertical Forest.
sentences.zh: 在荷兰，他还建造了垂直森林鲁多建筑。

sentences.en: This is a low-income apartment building with trees growing on all sides.
sentences.zh: 这是一座低收入公寓楼，四面都生长着树木。

sentences.en: Similar changes are also happening inside private homes.
sentences.zh: 类似的改变也发生在私人住宅内部。

sentences.en: In some, trees are brought right indoors.
sentences.zh: 在一些住宅中，树木被直接引入室内。

sentences.en: In others, outdoor trees are carefully placed as important partners in the building plan.
sentences.zh: 在另一些住宅中，户外树木被精心布置为建筑计划中的重要伙伴。

sentences.en: Some architects even build homes around existing trees.
sentences.zh: 有些建筑师甚至围绕现有树木建造房屋。

sentences.en: Others plant one or more trees inside the home.
sentences.zh: 另一些人会在室内栽种一棵或多棵树木。

sentences.en: And some architects or designers imagine natural settings indoors by using parts of trees.
sentences.zh: 有些建筑师或设计师则通过使用树木的部件，在室内营造出自然的环境。

sentences.en: These designs are meant to create the look and feel of real wood, while bringing feelings of peace and calm.
sentences.zh: 这些设计旨在呈现出真木的外观与质感，同时带来宁静与平和之感。

sentences.en: Ryoko Okada is an architect at New York City’s Oda Architecture.
sentences.zh: 冈田凉子是纽约市Oda建筑事务所的一名建筑师。

sentences.en: She told The Associated Press that she and her co-workers aim to bring outdoor elements indoors as often as they can.
sentences.zh: 她告诉美联社，她和同事们力求尽可能多地把户外元素引入室内。

sentences.en: “There’s nothing more calming than being surrounded by nature…” Okada said.
sentences.zh: “没有什么比被大自然环绕更令人放松的了……”冈田说道。

sentences.en: She added that a living tree indoors can bring peace and happiness as people watch it grow and change.
sentences.zh: 她还补充说，室内的一棵活树能带来平和与幸福，因为人们可以看着它生长和变化。

sentences.en: Another design example came from KAA Design Group in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 另一个设计范例来自洛杉矶的KAA设计集团。

sentences.en: A team from the company created a modern home that uses the property’s existing trees, such as cork oaks, rare Torrey pines, and magnolias.
sentences.zh: 该公司一个团队打造了一栋现代住宅，充分利用了该地块原有的树木，如栓皮栎、珍稀的托里松和木兰。

sentences.en: One very large, old cork oak sits in the center of the property.
sentences.zh: 一棵非常大、非常古老的栓皮栎矗立在地块的中央。

sentences.en: At first, the owners did not like the look and said they wanted the tree gone.
sentences.zh: 起初，业主们不喜欢它的外观，并表示希望把这棵树移除。

sentences.en: One of the company’s partners, Grant Kirkpatrick, had to persuade the homeowners to keep it.
sentences.zh: 公司的一位合伙人格兰特·柯克帕特里克不得不说服业主保留这棵树。

sentences.en: Kirkpatrick explained he succeeded by pointing out that the tree was “a 300-year-old antique that should be featured rather than removed.”
sentences.zh: 柯克帕特里克解释说，他之所以成功，是因为他指出这棵树“是一件有300年历史的古董，应当被突出展示，而非被移除。”

sentences.en: The driveway on that property also offers a calming design.
sentences.zh: 该地块的车道也采用了令人放松的设计。

sentences.en: A black pine tree rises up from the driveway like a piece of natural art.
sentences.zh: 一棵黑松从车道中拔地而起，宛如一件天然的艺术品。

sentences.en: In addition, views from almost every window in the house feature the beautiful nature outdoors.
sentences.zh: 此外，从屋内几乎每一扇窗户望出去，都能看到美丽的户外自然风光。

sentences.en: Okada says she suggests people do not plant a full-size tree in their home without first seeking expert advice.
sentences.zh: 冈田说她建议人们在室内栽种全尺寸的树木之前，应先征求专家的意见。

sentences.en: She notes that a living tree will only do well if certain conditions – such as air, light and soil – are right.
sentences.zh: 她指出，只有在空气、光照和土壤等条件都适宜的情况下，活树才能生长良好。

sentences.en: Okada added that a living tree “…needs to be supported by proper infrastructure to stay alive and avoid home damage.”
sentences.zh: 冈田补充说，活树“……需要依靠完善的基础设施来维持生命，并避免对房屋造成损害。”

sentences.en: She also urges people to heavily research a tree’s natural environment to avoid drawing in unwanted pests.
sentences.zh: 她还敦促人们深入研究某种树木的自然环境，以避免招来不受欢迎的害虫。

sentences.en: Kirkpatrick noted that planting a tree indoors can be difficult.
sentences.zh: 柯克帕特里克指出，在室内种树可能很困难。

sentences.en: He explained that at least 1.2 meters of soil depth is needed, along with lots of natural light and the right temperature.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，至少需要1.2米的土壤深度，同时还需要充足的自然光线和合适的温度。

sentences.en: Kirkpatrick said he worked on one property that experienced a serious fire in 2016.
sentences.zh: 柯克帕特里克说他曾处理过一处2016年遭遇严重火灾的房产。

sentences.en: His team decided to use parts from one of the burned manzanita trees in the interior design.
sentences.zh: 他的团队决定将烧毁的马齿苐树的部件用于室内设计。

sentences.en: The piece was painted black and placed inside the property.
sentences.zh: 这件作品被漆成黑色并放置在房产内部。

sentences.en: He said it now represents an eye-catching, natural art piece.
sentences.zh: 他说，如今它已成为一件引人注目的自然艺术品。
